sEn: Hindsight Experience Replay enables sample-efficient learning from sparse, binary rewards, eliminating the need for reward engineering.
sZh: 后见经验回放实现了从稀疏二元奖励中的样本高效学习，无需进行奖励工程。
absEn: Dealing with sparse rewards is one of the biggest challenges in Reinforcement Learning (RL). We present a novel technique called Hindsight Experience Replay which allows sample-efficient learning from rewards which are sparse and binary and therefore avoid the need for complicated reward engineering. It can be combined with an arbitrary off-policy RL algorithm and may be seen as a form of implicit curriculum. We demonstrate our approach on the task of manipulating objects with a robotic arm. In particular, we run experiments on three different tasks: pushing, sliding, and pick-and-place, in each case using only binary rewards indicating whether or not the task is completed. Our ablation studies show that Hindsight Experience Replay is a crucial ingredient which makes training possible in these challenging environments. We show that our policies trained on a physics simulation can be deployed on a physical robot and successfully complete the task.
absZh: 处理稀疏奖励是强化学习（RL）中最大的挑战之一。我们提出了一种称为事后经验回放（Hindsight Experience Replay）的新技术，该技术允许从稀疏且二元的奖励中进行样本高效学习，从而避免了对复杂奖励工程的需求。它可以与任意离策略RL算法结合，并可被视为一种隐式课程学习形式。我们在用机械臂操作物体的任务上展示了我们的方法。具体来说，我们在三个不同的任务上进行了实验：推动、滑动和抓取放置，每种情况下仅使用指示任务是否完成的二元奖励。我们的消融研究表明，事后经验回放是使得在这些具有挑战性的环境中能够进行训练的关键因素。我们展示了在物理仿真中训练的策略可以部署到实体机器人上并成功完成任务。

paras.en: arXiv:1707.01495v3 [cs.LG] 23 Feb 2018 Abstract Dealing with sparse rewards is one of the biggest challenges in Reinforcement Learning (RL). We present a novel technique called Hindsight Experience Replay which allows sample-efficient learning from rewards which are sparse and binary and therefore avoid the need for complicated reward engineering. It can be combined with an arbitrary off-policy RL algorithm and may be seen as a form of implicit curriculum. We demonstrate our approach on the task of manipulating objects with a robotic arm. In particular, we run experiments on three different tasks: pushing, sliding, and pick-and-place, in each case using only binary rewards indicating whether or not the task is completed. Our ablation studies show that Hindsight Experience Replay is a crucial ingredient which makes training possible in these challenging environments. We show that our policies trained on a physics simulation can be deployed on a physical robot and successfully complete the task. The video presenting our experiments is available at https://goo.gl/SMrQnI.
paras.zh: arXiv:1707.01495v3 [cs.LG] 2018年2月23日 摘要 处理稀疏奖励是强化学习（RL）中最大的挑战之一。我们提出了一种称为 Hindsight Experience Replay（事后经验回放）的新技术，它能够从稀疏且二值的奖励中进行样本高效的学习，从而避免了对复杂奖励工程的需求。它可以与任意的离策略（off-policy）强化学习算法结合，并可视为一种隐式课程。我们以机械臂操作物体为任务验证了我们的方法。具体来说，我们在三个不同的任务上进行了实验：推、滑动和拾取放置，每种情况仅使用指示任务是否完成的二值奖励。我们的消融研究表明，Hindsight Experience Replay 是使这些具有挑战性的环境能够训练的关键要素。我们展示了在物理仿真中训练的策略可以部署到实体机器人上并成功完成任务。展示我们实验的视频可在 https://goo.gl/SMrQnI 获取。

paras.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) combined with neural networks has recently led to a wide range of successes in learning policies for sequential decision-making problems. This includes simulated environments, such as playing Atari games (Mnih et al., 2015), and defeating the best human player at the game of Go (Silver et al., 2016), as well as robotic tasks such as helicopter control (Ng et al., 2006), hitting a baseball (Peters and Schaal, 2008), screwing a cap onto a bottle (Levine et al., 2015), or door opening (Chebotar et al., 2016). However, a common challenge, especially for robotics, is the need to engineer a reward function that not only reflects the task at hand but is also carefully shaped (Ng et al., 1999) to guide the policy optimization. For example, Popov et al. (2017) use a cost function consisting of five relatively complicated terms which need to be carefully weighted in order to train a policy for stacking a brick on top of another one. The necessity of cost engineering limits the applicability of RL in the real world because it requires both RL expertise and domain-specific knowledge. Moreover, it is not applicable in situations where we do not know what admissible behaviour may look like. It is therefore of great practical relevance to develop algorithms which can learn from unshaped reward signals, e.g. a binary signal indicating successful task completion. One ability humans have, unlike the current generation of model-free RL algorithms, is to learn almost as much from achieving an undesired outcome as from the desired one. Imagine that you are learning how to play hockey and are trying to shoot a puck into a net. You hit the puck but it misses the net on the right side. The conclusion drawn by a standard RL algorithm in such a situation would be that the performed sequence of actions does not lead to a successful shot, and little (if anything) would be learned.
paras.zh: 强化学习（RL）与神经网络相结合，近期在面向序贯决策问题的策略学习方面取得了广泛成功。这些成功既包括模拟环境，例如玩 Atari 游戏（Mnih 等，2015），以及在围棋对弈中击败最优秀的人类选手（Silver 等，2016）；也包括机器人任务，例如直升机控制（Ng 等，2006）、击打棒球（Peters 和 Schaal，2008）、将瓶盖拧到瓶子上（Levine 等，2015）或开门（Chebotar 等，2016）。然而，一个常见的挑战（尤其是对机器人领域而言）是：需要设计一个奖励函数，它不仅要反映手头的任务，还要经过仔细塑形（Ng 等，1999）来指导策略优化。例如，Popov 等（2017）使用了一个由五个相对复杂的项组成的代价函数，这些项需要仔细加权，才能训练出一个将积木叠放在另一块积木之上的策略。这种代价工程（cost engineering）的必要性限制了强化学习在现实世界中的适用性，因为它既需要强化学习专业知识，又需要领域特定知识。此外，在我们不知道什么样的行为是允许的情况下，这种方法也不适用。因此，开发能够从未塑形的奖励信号（例如一个指示任务是否成功完成的二值信号）中学习的算法，具有重大的实际意义。与当前一代无模型强化学习算法不同，人类具备一种能力：从达成一个不希望的结果中学到的东西，几乎与从期望结果中学到的一样多。想象你正在学习打冰球，并试图把球打进网内。你击中了球，但它从球网右侧偏出。在这种情况下，标准强化学习算法得出的结论是：所执行的动作序列并未导致一次成功的射门，因而（几乎）什么也学不到。

paras.en: It is however possible to draw another conclusion, namely that this sequence of actions would be successful if the net had been placed further to the right. In this paper we introduce a technique called Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) which allows the algorithm to perform exactly this kind of reasoning and can be combined with any off-policy RL algorithm. It is applicable whenever there are multiple goals which can be achieved, e.g. achieving each state of the system may be treated as a separate goal. Not only does HER improve the sample efficiency in this setting, but more importantly, it makes learning possible even if the reward signal is sparse and binary. Our approach is based on training universal policies (Schaul et al., 2015a) which take as input not only the current state, but also a goal state. The pivotal idea behind HER is to replay each episode with a different goal than the one the agent was trying to achieve, e.g. one of the goals which was achieved in the episode.
paras.zh: 然而，还可以得出另一个结论：如果球网当时再往右放一些，这一动作序列本可以成功。在本文中，我们提出一种名为“事后经验回放”（Hindsight Experience Replay, HER）的技术，它让算法能够进行上述这种推理，并且可以与任何离策略（off-policy）强化学习算法相结合。只要存在多个可以达到的目标，它就能适用；例如，把系统的每个状态都当作一个独立的目标。HER 不仅提高了这种设定下的样本效率，更重要的是，它使得即使奖励信号稀疏且为二值时也能进行学习。我们的方法基于训练通用策略（universal policies）（Schaul 等，2015a），这些策略不仅以当前状态作为输入，还以目标状态作为输入。HER 的关键思想是：在回放每个回合时，使用一个与智能体原本试图达到的目标不同的目标，例如使用该回合中实际达到的某个目标。

paras.en: In this section, we introduce the reinforcement learning formalism used in this paper, as well as the RL algorithms we employ in our experiments.
paras.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍本文使用的强化学习形式化框架，以及我们在实验中采用的RL算法。

paras.en: We consider the standard reinforcement learning formalism consisting of an agent interacting with an environment. To simplify the exposition we assume that the environment is fully observable. An environment is described by a set of states \(S\), a set of actions \(A\), a distribution of initial states \(p(s_0)\), a reward function \(r: S \times A \to R\), transition probabilities \(p(s_{t+1} | s_t, a_t)\), and a discount factor \(γ \in [0, 1]\). A deterministic policy is a mapping from states to actions: \(π: S \to A\). Every episode starts with sampling an initial state \(s_0\). At every timestep \(t\) the agent produces an action based on the current state: \(a_t = π(s_t)\). Then it gets the reward \(r_t = r(s_t, a_t)\) and the environment's new state is sampled from the distribution \(p(\cdot|s_t, a_t)\). A discounted sum of future rewards is called a return: \(R_t = \sum_{i=t}^{\infty} γ^{i−t} r_i\). The agent's goal is to maximize its expected return \(E_{s_0}[R_0 | s_0]\). The Q-function or action-value function is defined as \(Q^π(s_t, a_t) = E[R_t | s_t, a_t]\). Let \(π^*\) denote an optimal policy, i.e., any policy \(π^*\) such that \(Q^{π^*}(s, a) \geq Q^π(s, a)\) for every \(s \in S\), \(a \in A\) and any policy \(π\). All optimal policies have the same Q-function, which is called the optimal Q-function and denoted \(Q^*\). It is easy to show that it satisfies the following equation called the Bellman equation: \(Q^*(s, a) = E_{s' \sim p(\cdot|s,a)} [ r(s, a) + γ \max_{a'} Q^*(s', a') ]\).
paras.zh: 我们考虑由智能体与环境交互组成的标准强化学习形式化框架。为简化表述，我们假设环境完全可观测。环境由状态集合 \(S\)、动作集合 \(A\)、初始状态分布 \(p(s_0)\)、奖励函数 \(r: S \times A \to R\)、转移概率 \(p(s_{t+1} | s_t, a_t)\) 以及折扣因子 \(γ \in [0, 1]\) 描述。确定性策略是从状态到动作的映射：\(π: S \to A\)。每个回合从采样初始状态 \(s_0\) 开始。在每个时间步 \(t\)，智能体基于当前状态产生一个动作：\(a_t = π(s_t)\)。然后它获得奖励 \(r_t = r(s_t, a_t)\)，并且环境的新状态从分布 \(p(\cdot|s_t, a_t)\) 中采样。未来奖励的折扣和称为回报：\(R_t = \sum_{i=t}^{\infty} γ^{i−t} r_i\)。智能体的目标是最大化其期望回报 \(E_{s_0}[R_0 | s_0]\)。Q函数或动作价值函数定义为 \(Q^π(s_t, a_t) = E[R_t | s_t, a_t]\)。令 \(π^*\) 表示一个最优策略，即对任意 \(s \in S\)、\(a \in A\) 和任意策略 \(π\) 都满足 \(Q^{π^*}(s, a) \geq Q^π(s, a)\) 的策略。所有最优策略具有相同的Q函数，称为最优Q函数，记为 \(Q^*\)。容易证明它满足如下称为贝尔曼方程的等式：\(Q^*(s, a) = E_{s' \sim p(\cdot|s,a)} [ r(s, a) + γ \max_{a'} Q^*(s', a') ]\)。

paras.en: Deep Deterministic Policy Gradients (DDPG) (Lillicrap et al., 2015) is a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm for continuous action spaces. Here we sketch it only informally; see Lillicrap et al. (2015) for more details. In DDPG we maintain two neural networks: a target policy (also called an actor) \(π : S → A\) and an action-value function approximator (called the critic) \(Q : S × A → R\). The critic's job is to approximate the actor's action-value function \(Q^π\). Episodes are generated using a behavioral policy that is a noisy version of the target policy, e.g., \(π_b(s) = π(s) + N(0, 1)\). The critic is trained similarly to the Q-function in DQN, but the targets \(y_t\) are computed using actions output by the actor, i.e., \(y_t = r_t + γ Q(s_{t+1}, π(s_{t+1}))\). The actor is trained with mini-batch gradient descent on the loss \(L_a = -E_s [Q(s, π(s))]\), where \(s\) is sampled from the replay buffer. The gradient of \(L_a\) with respect to the actor parameters can be computed by backpropagation through the combined critic and actor networks.
paras.zh: 深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）(Lillicrap et al., 2015) 是一种用于连续动作空间的无模型强化学习（RL）算法。这里仅作非正式介绍；更多细节参见 Lillicrap et al. (2015)。在 DDPG 中我们维护两个神经网络：目标策略（也称为 actor）\(π : S → A\) 和动作值函数逼近器（称为 critic）\(Q : S × A → R\)。critic 的工作是逼近 actor 的动作值函数 \(Q^π\)。回合通过一个行为策略生成，该策略是目标策略的带噪声版本，例如 \(π_b(s) = π(s) + N(0, 1)\)。critic 的训练方式与 DQN 中的 Q 函数类似，但目标 \(y_t\) 使用 actor 输出的动作来计算，即 \(y_t = r_t + γQ(s_{t+1}, π(s_{t+1}))\)。actor 通过小批量梯度下降训练，损失为 \(L_a = -E_s [Q(s, π(s))]\)，其中 \(s\) 从经验回放缓冲区中采样。\(L_a\) 对 actor 参数的梯度可以通过组合的 critic 和 actor 网络进行反向传播来计算。

paras.en: Universal Value Function Approximators (UVFA) (Schaul et al., 2015a) is an extension of DQN to the setting where there is more than one goal we may try to achieve. Let \(G\) be the space of possible goals. Every goal \(g ∈ G\) corresponds to some reward function \(r_g : S × A → R\). Every episode starts by sampling a state-goal pair from some distribution \(p(s_0, g)\). The goal stays fixed for the whole episode. At every timestep the agent receives as input not only the current state but also the current goal; π : S × G → A and gets the reward \(r_t = r_g(s_t, a_t)\). The Q-function now depends not only on a state-action pair but also on a goal: \(Q^π(s_t, a_t, g) = E[R_t | s_t, a_t, g]\). Schaul et al. (2015a) show that in this setup it is possible to train an approximator to the Q-function using direct bootstrapping from the Bellman equation (just as in DQN) and that a greedy policy derived from it can generalize to previously unseen state-action pairs. The extension of this approach to DDPG is straightforward.
paras.zh: 通用价值函数逼近器（UVFA）(Schaul et al., 2015a) 是 DQN 的一种扩展，用于处理存在多个待实现目标的情形。设 \(G\) 为可能目标的集合。每个目标 \(g ∈ G\) 对应某个奖励函数 \(r_g : S × A → R\)。每个回合开始时从某个分布 \(p(s_0, g)\) 中采样一个状态-目标对。目标在整个回合中保持不变。在每个时间步，智能体接收的输入不仅包括当前状态，还包括当前目标；策略为 π : S × G → A，同时获得奖励 \(r_t = r_g(s_t, a_t)\)。Q 函数现在不仅依赖于状态-动作对，还依赖于目标：\(Q^π(s_t, a_t, g) = E[R_t | s_t, a_t, g]\)。Schaul et al. (2015a) 表明，在这种设置下，可以使用 Bellman 方程的直接自举（bootstrap）来训练 Q 函数的逼近器（就像 DQN 中一样），并且由此得到的贪心策略可以泛化到先前未见过的状态-动作对。将该方法扩展到 DDPG 是直接的。

The pivotal idea behind our approach is to re-examine this trajectory with a different goal — while this trajectory may not help us learn how to achieve the state g, it definitely tells us something about how to achieve the state sT . This information can be harvested by using an off-policy RL algorithm and experience replay where we replace g in the replay buffer by sT . In addition we can still replay with the original goal g left intact in the replay buffer. With this modification at least half of the replayed trajectories contain rewards different from −1 and learning becomes much simpler. Fig. 1 compares the final performance of DQN with and without this additional replay technique which we call Hindsight Experience Replay (HER). DQN without HER can only solve the task for n ≤ 13 while DQN with HER easily solves the task for n up to 50. See Appendix A for the details of the experimental setup. Note that this approach combined with powerful function approximators (e.g., deep neural networks) allows the agent to learn how to achieve the goal g even if it has never observed it during training. We more formally describe our approach in the following sections.

We are interested in training agents which learn to achieve multiple different goals. We follow the approach from Universal Value Function Approximators (Schaul et al., 2015a), i.e. we train policies and value functions which take as input not only a state \(s \in S\) but also a goal \(g \in G\). Moreover, we show that training an agent to perform multiple tasks can be easier than training it to perform only one task (see Sec. 4.3 for details) and therefore our approach may be applicable even if there is only one task we would like the agent to perform (a similar situation was recently observed by Pinto and Gupta (2016)). We assume that every goal \(g \in G\) corresponds to some predicate \(f_g : S \rightarrow {0, 1}\) and that the agent’s goal is to achieve any state \(s\) that satisfies \(f_g(s) = 1\). In the case when we want to exactly specify the desired state of the system we may use \(S = G\) and \(f_g(s) = [s = g]\). The goals can also specify only some properties of the state, e.g. suppose that \(S = \mathbb{R}^2\) and we want to be able to achieve an arbitrary state with the given value of x coordinate. In this case \(G = \mathbb{R\) and \(f_g((x, y)) = [x = g]\). Moreover, we assume that given a state \(s\) we can easily find a goal \(g\) which is satisfied in this state. More formally, we assume that there is given a mapping \(m : S \rightarrow G\) such that \(\forall s \in S, f_{m(s)}(s) = 1\). Notice that this assumption is not very restrictive and can usually be satisfied. In the case where each goal corresponds to a state we want to achieve, i.e. \(G = S\) and \(f_g(s) = [s = g]\), the mapping \(m\) is just an identity. For the case of 2-dimensional state and 1-dimensional goals from the previous paragraph this mapping is also very simple \(m((x, y)) = x\). A universal policy can be trained using an arbitrary RL algorithm by sampling goals and initial states from some distributions, running the agent for some number of timesteps and giving it a negative reward at every timestep when the goal is not achieved, i.e. \(r_g(s, a) = -[f_g(s) = 0]\). This does not however work very well in practice because this reward function is sparse and not very informative. In order to solve this problem we introduce the technique of Hindsight Experience Replay which is the crux of our approach.
paras.zh: 我们关注的是训练能够实现多个不同目标的智能体。我们沿用通用价值函数近似器（Universal Value Function Approximators，Schaul et al., 2015a）的方法，即训练策略和价值函数时，不仅以状态 \(s \in S\) 作为输入，还以目标 \(g \in G\) 作为输入。此外，我们会证明，训练智能体执行多个任务可能比训练它只执行一个任务更容易（详见第 4.3 节），因此即使我们只希望智能体执行一个任务，我们的方法也可能适用（Pinto 和 Gupta（2016）最近也观察到类似情况）。我们假设每个目标 \(g \in G\) 都对应某个谓词 \(f_g : S \rightarrow {0, 1}\)，并且智能体的目标是达到任意满足 \(f_g(s) = 1\) 的状态 \(s\)。当我们希望精确指定系统的目标状态时，可以令 \(S = G\) 且 \(f_g(s) = [s = g]\)。目标也可以只指定状态的某些属性，例如，假设 \(S = \mathbb{R}^2\)，我们希望达到具有给定 x 坐标值的任意状态。此时 \(G = \mathbb{R\) 且 \(f_g((x, y)) = [x = g]\)。此外，我们假设给定状态 \(s\) 后，可以很容易找到一个在该状态下得到满足的目标 \(g\)。更正式地说，我们假设存在一个映射 \(m : S \rightarrow G\)，使得 \(\forall s \in S, f_{m(s)}(s) = 1\)。注意，这个假设限制性不强，通常都能满足。在每个目标都对应一个我们希望达到的状态的情形下，即 \(G = S\) 且 \(f_g(s) = [s = g]\)，映射 \(m\) 就是恒等映射。对于上一段中二维状态和一维目标的例子，这个映射也非常简单：\(m((x, y)) = x\)。通用策略可以用任意强化学习算法来训练：从某些分布中采样目标和初始状态，让智能体运行若干时间步，并在每个目标未达成的时间步给予负奖励，即 \(r_g(s, a) = -[f_g(s) = 0]\)。然而，这种做法在实践中效果并不好，因为这个奖励函数是稀疏的，且信息量不大。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了事后经验回放（Hindsight Experience Replay）技术，这也是我们方法的核心。

paras.en: The idea behind Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) is very simple: after experiencing some episode \(s_0, s_1, \ldots, s_T\) we store in the replay buffer every transition \(s_t \rightarrow s_{t+1}\) not only with the original goal used for this episode but also with a subset of other goals. Notice that the goal being pursued influences the agent's actions but not the environment dynamics and therefore we can replay each trajectory with an arbitrary goal assuming that we use an off-policy RL algorithm like DQN (Mnih et al., 2015), DDPG (Lillicrap et al., 2015), NAF (Gu et al., 2016) or SDQN (Metz et al., 2017). One choice which has to be made in order to use HER is the set of additional goals used for replay. In the simplest version of our algorithm we replay each trajectory with the goal \(m(s_T)\), i.e. the goal which is achieved in the final state of the episode. We experimentally compare different types and quantities of additional goals for replay in Sec. 4.5. In all cases we also replay each trajectory with the original goal pursued in the episode. See Alg. 1 for a more formal description of the algorithm.
paras.zh: Hindsight Experience Replay（HER）背后的思想非常简单：在经历某个回合 \(s_0, s_1, \ldots, s_T\) 之后，我们不仅在回放缓冲池中存储每个转移 \(s_t \rightarrow s_{t+1}\)（使用该回合的原始目标），还使用其他目标的一个子集来存储。注意，所追求的目标会影响智能体的动作，但不会影响环境动态，因此我们可以假设使用离策略 RL 算法（如 DQN（Mnih et al., 2015）、DDPG（Lillicrap et al., 2015）、NAF（Gu et al., 2016）或 SDQN（Metz et al., 2017））时，用任意目标重放每条轨迹。使用 HER 必须做出的一个选择是用于重放的额外目标集合。在我们算法最简单的版本中，我们用目标 \(m(s_T)\) 重放每条轨迹，即在回合最终状态达到的目标。我们在第 4.5 节中实验比较了用于重放的不同类型和数量的额外目标。在所有情况下，我们也会用回合中所追求的原始目标重放每条轨迹。更正式的描述见算法 1。

paras.en:
**Algorithm 1** Hindsight Experience Replay (HER)

**Given:**
- An off-policy RL algorithm \(A\), e.g., DQN, DDPG, NAF, SDQN
- A strategy \(S\) for sampling goals for replay, e.g., \(S(s_0, \ldots, s_T) = m(s_T)\)
- A reward function \(r: \mathcal{S} \times \mathcal{A} \times \mathcal{G} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}\), e.g., \(r(s,a,g) = -\mathbb{I}[f_g(s) = 0]\)

**Initialize** \(A\), e.g., initialize neural networks
**Initialize** replay buffer \(R\)

**for** episode = 1, \(M\) **do**
  Sample a goal \(g\) and an initial state \(s_0\).
  **for** \(t = 0, T-1\) **do**
    Sample an action \(a_t\) using the behavioral policy from \(A\): \(a_t \leftarrow \pi_b(s_t \parallel g)\) (\parallel denotes concatenation)
    Execute the action \(a_t\) and observe a new state \(s_{t+1}\)
  **end for**
  **for** \(t = 0, T-1\) **do**
    \(r_t := r(s_t, a_t, g)\)
    Store the transition \((s_t \parallel g, a_t, r_t, s_{t+1} \parallel g)\) in \(R\) (standard experience replay)
    Sample a set of additional goals for replay \(G := S(current episode)\)
    **for** \(g' \in G\) **do**
      \(r' := r(s_t, a_t, g')\)
      Store the transition \((s_t \parallel g', a_t, r', s_{t+1} \parallel g')\) in \(R\) (HER)
    **end for**
  **end for**
  **for** \(t = 1, N\) **do**
    Sample a minibatch \(B\) from the replay buffer \(R\)
    Perform one step of optimization using \(A\) and minibatch \(B\)
  **end for**
**end for**
paras.zh:
**算法 1** Hindsight Experience Replay（HER）

**给定：**
- 一个离策略 RL 算法 \(A\)，例如 DQN、DDPG、NAF、SDQN
- 一个用于重放目标采样的策略 \(S\)，例如 \(S(s_0, \ldots, s_T) = m(s_T)\)
- 一个奖励函数 \(r: \mathcal{S} \times \mathcal{A} \times \mathcal{G} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}\)，例如 \(r(s,a,g) = -\mathbb{I}[f_g(s) = 0]\)

**初始化** \(A\)，例如初始化神经网络
**初始化** 经验回放缓冲池 \(R\)

**for** episode = 1, \(M\) **do**
  采样一个目标 \(g\) 和一个初始状态 \(s_0\)。
  **for** \(t = 0, T-1\) **do**
    使用来自 \(A\) 的行为策略采样一个动作 \(a_t\)：\(a_t \leftarrow \pi_b(s_t \parallel g)\)（\parallel 表示拼接）
    执行动作 \(a_t\) 并观察新状态 \(s_{t+1}\)
  **end for**
  **for** \(t = 0, T-1\) **do**
    \(r_t := r(s_t, a_t, g)\)
    将转移 \((s_t \parallel g, a_t, r_t, s_{t+1} \parallel g)\) 存入 \(R\)（标准经验回放）
    采样一个用于重放的额外目标集 \(G := S(current episode)\)
    **for** \(g' \in G\) **do**
      \(r' := r(s_t, a_t, g')\)
      将转移 \((s_t \parallel g', a_t, r', s_{t+1} \parallel g')\) 存入 \(R\)（HER）
    **end for**
  **end for**
  **for** \(t = 1, N\) **do**
    从回放缓冲池 \(R\) 采样一个小批量 \(B\)
    使用 \(A\) 和小批量 \(B\) 执行一步优化
  **end for**
**end for**

paras.en: HER may be seen as a form of implicit curriculum as the goals used for replay naturally shift from ones which are simple to achieve even by a random agent to more difficult ones. However, in contrast to explicit curriculum, HER does not require having any control over the distribution of initial environment states. Not only does HER learn with extremely sparse rewards, in our experiments it also performs better with sparse rewards than with shaped ones (See Sec. 4.4). These results are indicative of the practical challenges with reward shaping, and that shaped rewards would often constitute a compromise on the metric we truly care about (such as binary success/failure).
paras.zh: HER 可以被看作一种隐式课程形式，因为用于重放的目标会自然地从一个随机智能体也能轻易实现的简单目标，转移到更难的目标。然而，与显式课程相比，HER 不需要对环境初始状态的分布进行任何控制。HER 不仅能在极度稀疏的奖励下学习，在我们的实验中，它在稀疏奖励下的表现也优于塑形奖励（见第 4.4 节）。这些结果表明了奖励塑形在实际中的挑战，并且塑形奖励常常会对我们真正关心的指标（如二值成功/失败）构成一种妥协。

paras.en: The video presenting our experiments is available at https://goo.gl/SMrQnI. This section is organized as follows. In Sec. 4.1 we introduce the multi-goal RL environments used for the experiments as well as our training procedure. In Sec. 4.2 we compare the performance of DDPG with and without HER. In Sec. 4.3 we check whether HER improves performance in the single-goal setup. In Sec. 4.4 we analyze the effects of using shaped reward functions. In Sec. 4.5 we compare different strategies for sampling additional goals for HER. In Sec. 4.6 we show the results of the experiments on the physical robot.
paras.zh: 展示我们实验的视频可在 https://goo.gl/SMrQnI 获取。本节组织如下。第 4.1 节介绍我们在实验中使用的多目标强化学习环境以及训练流程。第 4.2 节比较 DDPG 在有和没有 HER 时的性能。第 4.3 节检查 HER 是否在单目标设置中提升性能。第 4.4 节分析使用塑形奖励函数的效果。第 4.5 节比较 HER 中采样额外目标的不同策略。第 4.6 节展示实体机器人上的实验结果。

paras.en: There are no standard environments for multi-goal RL, and therefore we created our own environments. We decided to use manipulation environments based on an existing hardware robot to ensure that the challenges we face correspond as closely as possible to the real world. In all experiments we use a 7-DOF Fetch Robotics arm which has a two-fingered parallel gripper. The robot is simulated using the MuJoCo (Todorov et al., 2012) physics engine. The whole training procedure is performed in the simulation but we show in Sec. 4.6 that the trained policies perform well on the physical robot without any fine-tuning.
paras.zh: 目前没有用于多目标强化学习（multi-goal RL）的标准环境，因此我们自行创建了环境。我们决定使用基于现有硬件机器人的操作环境，以确保所面临的挑战尽可能接近真实世界。在所有实验中，我们使用一个具有双指平行夹爪的 7 自由度 Fetch Robotics 机械臂。机器人使用 MuJoCo（Todorov 等，2012）物理引擎进行仿真。整个训练过程都在仿真中完成，但我们在第 4.6 节中表明，训练得到的策略无需任何微调即可在真实机器人上表现良好。

paras.en: Figure 2: Different tasks: pushing (top row), sliding (middle row) and pick-and-place (bottom row). The red ball denotes the goal position.
paras.zh: 图 2：不同任务：推（上排）、滑动（中排）和抓取放置（下排）。红球表示目标位置。

paras.en: Policies are represented as Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) with Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) activation functions. Training is performed using the DDPG algorithm (Lillicrap et al., 2015) with Adam (Kingma and Ba, 2014) as the optimizer. For improved efficiency we use 8 workers which average the parameters after every update. See Appendix A for more details and the values of all hyperparameters. We consider 3 different tasks:
paras.zh: 策略表示为多层感知机（MLP），激活函数为修正线性单元（ReLU）。训练采用 DDPG 算法（Lillicrap 等，2015），并使用 Adam（Kingma 和 Ba，2014）作为优化器。为提高效率，我们使用 8 个 worker（工作节点），在每次更新后对参数求平均。更多细节和所有超参数值见附录 A。我们考虑 3 个不同的任务：

paras.en:
1. **Pushing.** In this task a box is placed on a table in front of the robot and the task is to move it to the target location on the table. The robot fingers are locked to prevent grasping. The learned behaviour is a mixture of pushing and rolling.
2. **Sliding.** In this task a puck is placed on a long slippery table and the target position is outside of the robot's reach so that it has to hit the puck with such a force that it slides and then stops in the appropriate place due to friction.
3. **Pick-and-place.** This task is similar to pushing but the target position is in the air and the fingers are not locked. To make exploration in this task easier we recorded a single state in which the box is grasped and start half of the training episodes from this state.
paras.zh:
1. **推（Pushing）**：在此任务中，一个盒子被放置在机器人前方的桌子上，任务是将它移动到桌面上的目标位置。机器人手指被锁定以防止抓取。学习到的行为是推和滚动的混合。
2. **滑动（Sliding）**：在此任务中，一个冰球被放置在一条长而光滑的桌子上，目标位置在机器人可触及范围之外，因此它必须以合适的力击打冰球，使其滑动并在摩擦力作用下停在合适的位置。
3. **抓取放置（Pick-and-place）**：此任务与推类似，但目标位置在空中，且手指未被锁定。为了降低此任务的探索难度，我们记录了一个盒子被抓取的状态，并从该状态开始一半的训练回合。

paras.en: States: The state of the system is represented in the MuJoCo physics engine and consists of angles and velocities of all robot joints as well as positions, rotations and velocities (linear and angular) of all objects.
paras.zh: **状态（States）**：系统状态由 MuJoCo 物理引擎表示，包含所有机器人关节的角度和速度，以及所有物体的位置、旋转和速度（线速度和角速度）。

paras.en: Goals: Goals describe the desired position of the object (a box or a puck depending on the task) with some fixed tolerance of \(\epsilon\) i.e., \(G = \mathbb{R}^3\) and \(f_g(s) = [|g - s_{object}| \leq \epsilon]\), where \(s_{object}\) is the position of the object in the state s. The mapping from states to goals used in HER is simply \(m(s) = s_{object}\).
paras.zh: 目标：目标描述物体（根据任务不同，可以是盒子或冰球）的期望位置，并带有某个固定容差 \(\epsilon\)，即 \(G = \mathbb{R}^3\) 且 \(f_g(s) = [|g - s_{object}| \leq \epsilon]\)，其中 \(s_{object}\) 是状态 s 中物体的位置。HER 中使用的从状态到目标的映射就是 \(m(s) = s_{object}\)。

paras.en: Rewards: Unless stated otherwise we use binary and sparse rewards \(r(s, a, g) = -[f_g(s') = 0]\) where s' is the state after the execution of the action a in the state s. We compare sparse and shaped reward functions in Sec. 4.4.
paras.zh: 奖励：除非另有说明，我们使用二元稀疏奖励 \(r(s, a, g) = -[f_g(s') = 0]\)，其中 s' 是在状态 s 下执行动作 a 之后的状态。我们在第 4.4 节比较稀疏和塑形奖励函数。

paras.en: State-goal distributions: For all tasks the initial position of the gripper is fixed, while the initial position of the object and the target are randomized. See Appendix A for details.
paras.zh: 状态-目标分布：对于所有任务，夹爪的初始位置是固定的，而物体和目标的初始位置是随机化的。详见附录 A。

paras.en: 3 This was necessary because we could not successfully train any policies for this task without using the demonstration state. We have later discovered that training is possible without this trick if only the goal position is sometimes on the table and sometimes in the air.
paras.zh: 3 这是必要的，因为如果不使用演示状态，我们就无法成功训练该任务的任何策略。我们后来发现，如果目标位置有时在桌面上、有时在空中，那么不用这个技巧也能进行训练。

paras.en: 6 Observations: In this paragraph relative means relative to the current gripper position. The policy is given as input the absolute position of the gripper, the relative position of the object and the target^4, as well as the distance between the fingers. The Q-function is additionally given the linear velocity of the gripper and fingers as well as relative linear and angular velocity of the object. We decided to restrict the input to the policy in order to make deployment on the physical robot easier.
paras.zh: 6 观察：在本段中，“相对”是指相对于当前夹爪位置。策略的输入是夹爪的绝对位置、物体和目标的相对位置^4，以及手指之间的距离。Q 函数还会额外输入夹爪和手指的线速度，以及物体的相对线速度和角速度。我们决定限制策略的输入，以便于在物理机器人上进行部署。

paras.en: Actions: None of the problems we consider require gripper rotation and therefore we keep it fixed. Action space is 4-dimensional. Three dimensions specify the desired relative gripper position at the next timestep. We use MuJoCo constraints to move the gripper towards the desired position but Jacobian-based control could be used instead^5. The last dimension specifies the desired distance between the two fingers which are position-controlled.
paras.zh: 动作：我们考虑的所有问题都不需要夹爪旋转，因此我们将其保持固定。动作空间是4维的。三个维度指定下一步期望的相对夹爪位置。我们使用MuJoCo约束将夹爪移动到期望位置，但也可以使用基于雅可比的控制^5。最后一个维度指定两个手指之间的期望距离，这两个手指是位置控制的。

paras.en: Strategy S for sampling goals for replay: Unless stated otherwise, HER uses replay with the goal corresponding to the final state in each episode, i.e., \(S(s_0, \ldots, s_T) = m(s_T)\). We compare different strategies for choosing which goals to replay with in Sec. 4.5.
paras.zh: 用于重放目标采样的策略S：除非另有说明，HER使用与每个回合最终状态对应的目标进行重放，即 \(S(s_0, \ldots, s_T) = m(s_T)\)。我们在第4.5节比较不同的目标选择策略。

paras.en: In order to verify if HER improves performance we evaluate DDPG with and without HER on all 3 tasks. Moreover, we compare against DDPG with count-based exploration6 (Strehl and Littman, 2005; Kolter and Ng, 2009; Tang et al., 2016; Bellemare et al., 2016; Ostrovski et al., 2017). For HER we store each transition in the replay buffer twice: once with the goal used for the generation of the episode and once with the goal corresponding to the final state from the episode (we call this strategy final). In Sec. 4.5 we perform ablation studies of different strategies S for choosing goals for replay, here we include the best version from Sec. 4.5 in the plot for comparison.

On the other hand, DDPG with HER solves all tasks almost perfectly. paras.en: 4.3 Does HER improve performance even if there is only one goal we care about?
paras.zh: 4.3 即便我们只关心一个目标，HER 是否也能提升性能？

paras.en: In this section we evaluate whether HER improves performance in the case where there is only one goal we care about. To this end, we repeat the experiments from the previous section but the goal state is identical in all episodes. From Fig. 4 it is clear that DDPG+HER performs much better than pure DDPG even if the goal state is identical in all episodes. More importantly, comparing Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 we can also notice that HER learns faster if training episodes contain multiple goals, so in practice it is advisable to train on multiple goals even if we care only about one of them.
paras.zh: 在本节中，我们评估在只关心一个目标的情况下，HER 是否能提升性能。为此，我们重复上一节的实验，但所有回合中的目标状态都是相同的。从图 4 可以清楚地看出，即使目标状态在所有回合中都相同，DDPG+HER 的表现也远好于纯 DDPG。更重要的是，对比图 3 和图 4 我们还可以注意到，如果训练回合包含多个目标，HER 学习得更快，因此在实践中，即使我们只关心其中一个目标，也建议在多个目标上进行训练。

full.sec: 4.4 How does HER interact with reward shaping?
full.secZh: 4.4 HER 如何与奖励塑形交互？

paras.en: So far we only considered binary rewards of the form \(r(s, a, g) = -[|g - s_{object}| > \epsilon]\). In this section we check how the performance of DDPG with and without HER changes if we replace this reward with a shaped one. We considered reward functions of the form \(r(s, a, g) = \lambda |g - s_{object}|^p - |g - s'_{object}|^p\), where \s'\ is the state of the environment after the execution of action \a\ in state \s\, and \lambda \in \lbrace 0, 1\rbrace\, \p \in \lbrace 1, 2\rbrace\ are hyperparameters. Fig. 5 shows the results. Surprisingly, neither DDPG nor DDPG+HER was able to successfully solve any of the tasks with any of these reward functions.^8 Our results are consistent with the fact that successful applications of RL to difficult manipulation tasks that do not use demonstrations usually have more complicated reward functions than the ones we tried (e.g. Popov et al. (2017)). The following two reasons can cause shaped rewards to perform so poorly: (1) There is a huge discrepancy between what we optimize (i.e. a shaped reward function) and the success condition (i.e. whether the object is within some radius from the goal at the end of the episode); (2) Shaped rewards penalize inappropriate behaviour (e.g. moving the box in a wrong direction), which may hinder exploration. This can cause the agent to learn not to touch the box at all if it cannot manipulate it precisely, and we noticed such behaviour in some of our experiments. Our results suggest that domain-agnostic reward shaping does not work well (at least in the simple forms we have tried). Of course, for every problem there exists a reward that makes it easy (Ng et al., 1999), but designing such shaped rewards requires a lot of domain knowledge and may in some cases not be much easier than directly scripting the policy. This strengthens our belief that learning from sparse, binary rewards is an important problem. Footnote 8: We also tried to rescale the distances, so that the range of rewards is similar as in the case of binary rewards, clipping big distances and adding a simple (linear or quadratic) term encouraging the gripper to move towards the object, but none of these techniques have led to successful training.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，我们只考虑了形式为 \(r(s, a, g) = -[|g - s_{object}| > \epsilon]\) 的二元奖励。在本节中，我们检查在将这种奖励替换为塑形奖励后，DDPG 和 DDPG+HER 的性能会如何变化。我们考虑了如下形式的奖励函数：\(r(s, a, g) = \lambda |g - s_{object}|^p - |g - s'_{object}|^p\)，其中 \s'\ 是在状态 \s\ 中执行动作 \a\ 后的环境状态，\lambda \in \lbrace 0, 1\rbrace\、\p \in \lbrace 1, 2\rbrace\ 是超参数。图 5 展示了结果。令人惊讶的是，无论使用哪种奖励函数，DDPG 和 DDPG+HER 都无法成功解决任何任务。^8 我们的结果与以下事实一致：在不需要示范的困难操作任务中，成功的强化学习应用通常使用比我们尝试过的更复杂的奖励函数（例如 Popov 等，2017）。以下两个原因可能导致塑形奖励表现如此糟糕：（1）我们优化的目标（即塑形奖励函数）与成功条件（即回合结束时目标是否在物体的一定半径内）之间存在巨大差异；（2）塑形奖励会对不恰当的行为（例如将盒子推向错误方向）施加惩罚，这可能会妨碍探索。这可能导致智能体学会在无法精确操作盒子时完全不接触它，我们在一些实验中也注意到了这种行为。我们的结果表明，与领域无关的奖励塑形效果不佳（至少在我们尝试过的简单形式中如此）。当然，对于每个问题都存在一种使其易于解决的奖励（Ng 等，1999），但设计这种塑形奖励需要大量领域知识，并且在某些情况下可能并不比直接编写策略脚本容易多少。这进一步坚定了我们的信念：从稀疏的二元奖励中学习是一个重要问题。脚注 8：我们还尝试了对距离进行重新缩放，以使奖励的范围与二元奖励的情况相似、裁剪大的距离，并添加一个简单的（线性或二次）项来鼓励夹爪移向物体，但这些技术都没有带来成功的训练。

full.secZh: 4.6 在实体机器人上的部署

paras.en: We took a policy for the pick-and-place task trained in the simulator (version with the future strategy and \(k=4\) from Sec. 4.5) and deployed it on a physical Fetch robot without any fine-tuning. The box position was predicted using a separately trained CNN using raw Fetch head camera images. See Appendix B for details. Initially the policy succeeded in 2 out of 5 trials. It was not robust to small errors in the box position estimation because it was trained on perfect state coming from the simulation. After retraining the policy with Gaussian noise (\(\text{std}=1\text{ cm}\)) added to observations[10], the success rate increased to 5/5. The video showing some of the trials is available at https://goo.gl/SMrQnI.
paras.zh: 我们将在仿真器中训练好的抓取放置任务策略（采用第4.5节中的未来策略且 \(k=4\) 的版本）部署到真实的 Fetch 机器人上，未进行任何微调。使用一个单独训练的 CNN，基于 Fetch 头部相机原始图像来预测箱子位置。详见附录 B。最初该策略在 5 次试验中成功了 2 次。由于策略是在仿真提供的完美状态上训练的，因此对箱子位置估计中的小误差不够鲁棒。在向观测加入高斯噪声（标准差 = 1 厘米）重新训练策略后，成功率提高到 5/5。展示部分试验的视频见 https://goo.gl/SMrQnI。

paras.en: The technique of experience replay was introduced in Lin (1992) and became very popular after it was used in the DQN agent playing Atari (Mnih et al., 2015). Prioritized experience replay (Schaul et al., 2015b) is an improvement to experience replay that prioritizes transitions in the replay buffer to speed up training. It is orthogonal to our work, and both approaches can be easily combined. Learning policies for multiple tasks simultaneously has been heavily explored in the context of policy search, e.g., Schmidhuber and Huber (1990); Caruana (1998); Da Silva et al. (2012); Kober et al. (2012); Devin et al. (2016); Pinto and Gupta (2016). Learning off-policy value functions for multiple tasks was investigated by Foster and Dayan (2002) and Sutton et al. (2011). Our work is most heavily based on Schaul et al. (2015a), who consider training a single neural network to approximate multiple value functions. Learning to perform multiple tasks simultaneously has also been investigated for a long time in the context of Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning, e.g., Bakker and Schmidhuber (2004); Vezhnevets et al. (2017). Our approach may be seen as a form of implicit curriculum learning (Elman, 1993; Bengio et al., 2009). While curriculum learning is now often used for training neural networks (e.g., Zaremba and Sutskever (2014); Graves et al. (2016)), the curriculum is almost always hand-crafted. The problem of automatic curriculum generation was approached by Schmidhuber (2004), who constructed an asymptotically optimal algorithm for this problem using program search. Another interesting approach is PowerPlay (Schmidhuber, 2013; Srivastava et al., 2013), which is a general framework for automatic task selection. Graves et al. (2017) consider a setup with a fixed discrete set of tasks and empirically evaluate different strategies for automatic curriculum generation in this setting. Another approach investigated by Sukhbaatar et al. (2017) and Held et al. (2017) uses self-play between the policy and a task-setter to automatically generate goal states that lie at the boundary of what the current policy can achieve. Our approach is orthogonal to these techniques and can be combined with them.
paras.zh: 经验回放技术由 Lin (1992) 提出，并在 DQN 智能体玩 Atari 游戏（Mnih et al., 2015）中使用后变得非常流行。优先经验回放（Schaul et al., 2015b）是经验回放的一种改进，它对回放缓冲区中的转移进行优先排序以加速训练。它与我们的工作正交，两种方法可以很容易地结合。在策略搜索背景下，同时为多个任务学习策略已被广泛探索，例如 Schmidhuber and Huber (1990); Caruana (1998); Da Silva et al. (2012); Kober et al. (2012); Devin et al. (2016); Pinto and Gupta (2016)。Foster and Dayan (2002) 和 Sutton et al. (2011) 研究了为多个任务学习离策略价值函数。我们的工作最主要基于 Schaul et al. (2015a)，他们考虑训练单个神经网络来近似多个价值函数。在分层强化学习背景下，同时学习执行多个任务也被研究了很长时间，例如 Bakker and Schmidhuber (2004); Vezhnevets et al. (2017)。我们的方法可以被视为一种隐式课程学习（Elman, 1993; Bengio et al., 2009）。虽然课程学习现在常被用于训练神经网络（例如 Zaremba and Sutskever (2014); Graves et al. (2016)），但课程几乎总是手工设计的。Schmidhuber (2004) 通过程序搜索为该问题构造了一种渐近最优算法，从而解决了自动课程生成的问题。另一个有趣的方法是 PowerPlay（Schmidhuber, 2013; Srivastava et al., 2013），它是一个用于自动任务选择的通用框架。Graves et al. (2017) 考虑了一个具有固定离散任务集的设置，并在该设置下实证评估了不同的自动课程生成策略。Sukhbaatar et al. (2017) 和 Held et al. (2017) 研究的另一种方法利用策略与任务设定者之间的自博弈，自动生成位于当前策略能力边界附近的目标状态。我们的方法与这些技术正交，并且可以与它们结合。

paras.en: We introduced a novel technique called Hindsight Experience Replay, which makes it possible to apply RL algorithms to problems with sparse and binary rewards. Our technique can be combined with an arbitrary off-policy RL algorithm, and we experimentally demonstrated this with DQN and DDPG. We showed that HER allows training policies that push, slide, and pick-and-place objects with a robotic arm to specified positions, while the vanilla RL algorithm fails to solve these tasks. We also showed that the policy for the pick-and-place task performs well on the physical robot without any fine-tuning. As far as we know, this is the first time such complicated behaviors were learned using only sparse, binary rewards.
paras.zh: 我们提出了一种名为“事后经验回放”（Hindsight Experience Replay, HER）的新技术，使得强化学习（RL）算法能够应用于具有稀疏和二元奖励的问题。我们的技术可以与任意离策略（off-policy）RL 算法结合，并通过 DQN 和 DDPG 进行了实验验证。我们表明，HER 能够训练策略，使机械臂将物体推到、滑动并抓取放置到指定位置，而传统的 RL 算法无法解决这些任务。我们还表明，用于抓取放置任务的策略在物理机器人上表现良好，无需任何微调。据我们所知，这是首次仅使用稀疏二元奖励就学会了如此复杂的行为。

paras.en: In this section, we provide more details on our experimental setup and the hyperparameters used.
paras.zh: 在本节中，我们提供有关实验设置和所用超参数的更多细节。

paras.en: Bit-flipping experiment: We used a network with one hidden layer containing 256 neurons. The length of each episode was equal to the number of bits, and the episode was considered successful if the goal state was achieved at any timestep during the episode. All other hyperparameters were the same as in the DDPG experiments.
paras.zh: 比特翻转实验：我们使用了一个包含 256 个神经元的单隐藏层网络。每个回合的长度等于比特数；如果在回合中的任意时间步达到了目标状态，则该回合被视为成功。所有其他超参数与 DDPG 实验中的相同。

paras.en: State-goal distributions: For all tasks, the initial position of the gripper is fixed. For the pushing and sliding tasks, it is located just above the table surface, and for pick-and-place, it is located 20 cm above the table. The object is placed randomly on the table in a 30 cm × 30 cm square (20 cm × 20 cm for sliding), with the center directly under the gripper (both objects are 5 cm wide). For pushing, the goal state is sampled uniformly from the same square as the box position. In the pick-and-place task, the target is located in the air to force the robot to grasp (and not just push). The x and y coordinates of the goal position are sampled uniformly from the aforementioned square, and the height is sampled uniformly between 10 cm and 45 cm. For sliding, the goal position is sampled from a 60 cm × 60 cm square centered 40 cm away from the initial gripper position. For all tasks, we discard initial state-goal pairs in which the goal is already satisfied.
paras.zh: 状态-目标分布：对于所有任务，机械爪的初始位置是固定的。对于推和滑动任务，它位于桌面正上方；对于抓取与放置任务，它位于桌面上方 20 cm 处。物体被随机放置在桌面上一个 30 cm × 30 cm（滑动任务为 20 cm × 20 cm）的正方形区域内，该正方形的中心位于机械爪正下方（两个物体宽均为 5 cm）。对于推任务，目标状态从与箱子位置相同的正方形区域内均匀采样。在抓取与放置任务中，目标位于空中，以迫使机器人进行抓取（而不仅仅是推）。目标位置的 x 和 y 坐标从上述正方形区域均匀采样，高度在 10 cm 到 45 cm 之间均匀采样。对于滑动任务，目标位置从一个 60 cm × 60 cm 的正方形区域中采样，该区域中心位于距初始机械爪位置 40 cm 处。对于所有任务，我们丢弃目标已经满足的初始状态-目标对。

paras.en: Network architecture: Both actor and critic networks have 3 hidden layers with 64 hidden units in each layer. Hidden layers use ReLU activation function and the actor output layer uses tanh. The output of the tanh is then rescaled so that it lies in the range [−5 cm, 5 cm]. In order to prevent tanh saturation and vanishing gradients, we add the square of their preactivations to the actor's cost function.
paras.zh: 网络架构：Actor 和 Critic 网络都有 3 个隐藏层，每层 64 个隐藏单元。隐藏层使用 ReLU 激活函数，Actor 输出层使用 tanh。tanh 的输出被重新缩放，使其位于 [−5 cm, 5 cm] 范围内。为了防止 tanh 饱和和梯度消失，我们将它们预激活的平方添加到 Actor 的损失函数中。

paras.en: Training procedure: We train for 200 epochs. Each epoch consists of 50 cycles where each cycle consists of running the policy for 16 episodes and then performing 40 optimization steps on minibatches of size 128 sampled uniformly from a replay buffer consisting of \( 10^6 \) transitions. We update the target networks after every cycle using the decay coefficient of 0.95. Apart from using the target network for computing Q-targets for the critic, we also use it in testing episodes as it is more stable than the main network. The whole training procedure is distributed over 8 threads. For the Adam optimization algorithm, we use the learning rate of 0.001 and the default values from TensorFlow framework (Abadi et al., 2016) for the other hyperparameters. We use the discount factor of \( \gamma = 0.98 \) for all transitions including the ones ending an episode. Moreover, we clip the targets used to train the critic to the range of possible values, i.e. \( [-\frac{1}{1-\gamma}, 0] \).
paras.zh: 训练过程：我们训练 200 个 epoch。每个 epoch 由 50 个 cycle 组成，每个 cycle 包括运行策略 16 个 episode，然后在从包含 \( 10^6 \) 条转移的重放缓冲区中均匀采样的 128 大小的 minibatch 上执行 40 次优化步骤。我们在每个 cycle 后使用衰减系数 0.95 更新目标网络。除了使用目标网络计算 Critic 的 Q-target 外，我们还在测试 episode 中使用它，因为它比主网络更稳定。整个训练过程分布在 8 个线程上。对于 Adam 优化算法，我们使用学习率 0.001，其他超参数使用 TensorFlow 框架的默认值（Abadi 等人，2016）。我们对所有转移使用折扣因子 \( \gamma = 0.98 \)，包括结束 episode 的转移。此外，我们将用于训练 Critic 的目标裁剪到可能值的范围，即 \( [-\frac{1}{1-\gamma}, 0] \)。

paras.en: Input scaling: Neural networks have problems dealing with inputs of different magnitudes and therefore it is crucial to scale them properly. To this end, we rescale inputs to neural networks so that they have mean zero and standard deviation equal to one and then clip them to the range [−5, 5]. Means and standard deviations used for rescaling are computed using all the observations encountered so far in the training.
paras.zh: 输入缩放：神经网络在处理不同数量级的输入时存在问题，因此正确缩放它们至关重要。为此，我们重新缩放神经网络的输入，使其均值为零、标准差为 1，然后将它们裁剪到 [−5, 5] 范围内。用于重新缩放的均值和标准差使用训练中迄今为止遇到的所有观测值计算。

paras.en: Exploration: The behavioral policy we use for exploration works as follows. With probability 20% we sample (uniformly) a random action from the hypercube of valid actions. Otherwise, we take the output of the policy network and add independently to every coordinate normal noise with standard deviation equal to 5% of the total range of allowed values on this coordinate.
paras.zh: 探索：我们用于探索的行为策略如下：以 20% 的概率从有效动作的超立方体中（均匀）采样一个随机动作。否则，我们取策略网络的输出，并独立地在每个坐标上添加正态噪声，其标准差等于该坐标允许值总范围的 5%。

paras.en: Simulation: Every episode consists of 50 environment timesteps, each of which consists of 10 MuJoCo steps with \( \Delta t = 0.002 \text{s} \). MuJoCo uses soft constraints for contacts and therefore object penetration is possible. It can be minimized by using a small timestep and more constraint solver epochs but it would slow down the simulation. We encountered some penetration in the pushing task (the agent learnt to push the box into the table in a way that it is pushed out by contact forces onto the target). In order to avoid this behaviour we added to the reward a term penalizing the squared depth of penetration for every contact pair.
paras.zh: 模拟：每个 episode 包含 50 个环境时间步，每个环境时间步包含 10 个 MuJoCo 步，\( \Delta t = 0.002 \text{s} \)。MuJoCo 对接触使用软约束，因此物体穿透是可能的。可以通过使用小时间步和更多的约束求解器迭代来最小化穿透，但这会减慢模拟速度。我们在推箱子任务中遇到了一些穿透（智能体学会了将箱子推入桌子中，以使其被接触力推到目标上）。为了避免这种行为，我们在奖励中添加了一个惩罚每个接触对穿透深度平方的项。

paras.en: Training time: Training for 200 epochs took us approximately 2.5 hours for pushing and the pick-and-place tasks and 6 hours for sliding (because physics simulation was slower for this task) using 8 CPU cores.
paras.zh: 训练时间：在 8 个 CPU 核上，训练 200 轮（epochs）大约需要 2.5 小时用于推（pushing）和抓取放置（pick-and-place）任务，滑动（sliding）任务则需要 6 小时（因为该任务的物理模拟较慢）。

paras.en: B Deployment on the physical robot We have trained a convolutional neural network (CNN) which predicts the box position given the raw image from the Fetch head camera. The CNN was trained using only images coming from the MuJoCo renderer. Despite the fact that training images were not photorealistic, the trained network performs well on real world data thanks to a high degree of randomization of textures, lighting and other visual parameters in training. This approach called domain randomization is described in more detail in Tobin et al. (2017). At the beginning of each episode we initialize a simulated environment using the box position predicted by the CNN and robot state coming from the physical robot. From this point we run the policy in the simulator. After each timestep we send the simulated robot joint angles to the real one which is position-controlled and uses the simulated data as targets.
paras.zh: B 在实体机器人上的部署 我们训练了一个卷积神经网络（CNN），用于根据 Fetch 头部摄像头拍摄的原始图像预测箱子的位置。该 CNN 仅使用来自 MuJoCo 渲染器的图像进行训练。尽管训练图像并非照片级逼真，但由于训练过程中对纹理、光照及其他视觉参数进行了高度随机化，训练后的网络在真实世界数据上表现良好。这种方法称为域随机化（domain randomization），在 Tobin 等人（2017）中有更详细的描述。在每个回合开始时，我们利用 CNN 预测的箱子位置和来自实体机器人的状态来初始化模拟环境。此后，我们在模拟器中运行策略。每经过一个时间步，我们将模拟机器人的关节角度发送给实体机器人，后者采用位置控制，并以模拟数据作为目标。
